plain_description.what: An earlier anchor-free tree built with the gemma embedder on MASSIVE intents had only 4 leaves. This test rebuilt it with a separation threshold recalibrated for gemma's own embedding space, rather than the threshold tuned for the default qwen3 embedder.
plain_description.why: It asks whether the tiny gemma tree came from an unfair threshold tuned for another embedder, or from the recipe itself.
plain_description.information: Many leaves would blame the threshold. A tiny tree again would point at the recipe for this embedder. Result: done, valid. The gemma-calibrated threshold came out stricter, not looser (0.044 vs 0.025), and the tree never split (1 leaf), so the comparison with gemma k-means could not be scored. Conclusion, in this form only: the anchor-free recipe does not build a gemma MASSIVE tree under this threshold rule. It does not show the recipe fails at every threshold, nor 'no structure'.
